title: Cascading Relevance-driven Recommendation Network for CTR Prediction in Trigger-Introduced Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.22973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: E-commerce has emerged as crucial platforms for people's daily consumption and shopping interests. There is a new recommendation scenario, Trigger-Introduced Recommendation (TIR), where users click interested product, which is defined as the trigger item, containing their instant interest, and in the undertaking page following the relevant target items. Distinguished from traditional search and recommendation scenarios, trigger contains relatively strong instant interest, which is more vague and implicit compared to search terms. Relying on large amounts of labeled data, existing methods lack the exploration of trigger relevance, which affects users' immersive experience. To alleviate this problem, we propose the Cascading Relevance-driven Recommendation Network (CRRN) to emphasize the interaction and relevance between trigger and target, comprising three essential components: 1) the Trigger-Target Interaction layer extracts interaction

translated_title: 级联相关性驱动的推荐网络用于触发引入推荐中的点击率预测
translated_abstract: 电子商务已成为人们日常消费和购物兴趣的重要平台。存在一种新的推荐场景，即触发引入推荐（TIR），其中用户点击感兴趣的商品，该商品被定义为触发项，包含用户的即时兴趣，并在后续页面中展示相关目标商品。与传统的搜索和推荐场景不同，触发项包含相对强烈的即时兴趣，但与搜索词相比更模糊和隐含。现有方法依赖大量标注数据，缺乏对触发相关性的探索，这影响了用户的沉浸式体验。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了级联相关性驱动的推荐网络（CRRN），以强调触发项和目标项之间的交互和相关性，包含三个关键组件：1）触发-目标交互层提取交互信息。
tldr: 提出了一种级联相关性驱动的推荐网络，通过增强触发项与目标项之间的交互和相关性来提升触发引入推荐场景中的点击率预测性能。
en_tdlr: We propose a cascading relevance-driven recommendation network that enhances trigger-target interaction and relevance to improve CTR prediction in trigger-introduced recommendation scenarios.
